name: net_boot_resume_while_loading_ends_the_resume
description: A --join game killed while its match still loads is started again: Identity.held_seat names the seat, so its first HELLO is a boot resume. The server takes the seat back while the match loads and sends MATCH_CONFIG as at the start, without the rejoin flag (match.py rejoin; shared/net/README.md Rejoin: 'loads like any seat'), here fed to the MatchClient as the server's messages. That plain MATCH_CONFIG ends the resume: the game loads and plays as any seat, its overlay shows nothing, and a later RESYNC(desync) as a minority is loaded, not refused as out of its limits.

steps.msg: started again with a noted seat: a boot resume
the plain MATCH_CONFIG of a match still loading: it loads like any seat
the plain MATCH_CONFIG ended the boot resume
the overlay shows nothing while the game plays its seat (1 would be Reconnecting)
a RESYNC(desync) as a minority is loaded, the link kept
and the RESYNC loaded was the desync's
